FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Active Leisure Club operates as a premier recreation facility, offering a diverse range of activities including tennis, swimming, and fitness classes in a safe and welcoming environment. Our club is dedicated to promoting an active lifestyle for individuals and families within the community. We maintain high standards of safety through comprehensive employee training programs, regular equipment inspections, and rigorous adherence to local health and safety regulations. 

Our facility features controlled access points and surveillance systems to enhance the security of our patrons and staff. We focus on moderate-risk activities that promote engagement and well-being without exposing our members to high-risk scenarios. We pride ourselves on our strong financial health and operational stability, ensuring we can continually provide quality service and facilities to our members. Additionally, we thoroughly evaluate all sponsored events for liability exposures, ensuring an enjoyable and secure environment for all participants.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On January 10, 2023, during a routine maintenance check, a falling ceiling tile caused a minor injury to a patron, resulting in a claim for medical expenses amounting to $2,500; this claim is currently under review. Additionally, on March 5, 2023, equipment failure during a fitness class resulted in equipment damage totaling $6,000, which has been resolved and the equipment has been replaced.
FIELDS.Combined Single Limit: $1,000,000 Combined Single Limit with a $1,000 deductible
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class 1, Grade B Safe, UL listed, with reinforced steel construction for secure storage of cash and valuables.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing and surveillance camera system installed throughout the facility for enhanced safety and protection of patrons and staff.
FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – Active Leisure Club does not have any past, present, or discontinued operations involving the storing, treating, discharging, applying, disposing, or transporting of hazardous materials. Our facility is dedicated to maintaining a safe and compliant environment for all patrons.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: Yes – Active Leisure Club sponsors various athletic teams, promoting community engagement and physical activity among members. We evaluate all sponsored activities carefully to manage potential liability exposures.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Sub-contractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. The management team, including the facility manager, is responsible for checking these certificates.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – There have been no indictments or convictions related to fraud, bribery, arson, or any other arson-related crimes associated with the applicant or the property. The organization maintains a strong commitment to ethical operations and compliance.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – Active Leisure Club has not had any policy or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed in the prior three years. Our insurance history has been consistent and reliable.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Active Leisure Club does not lease employees to or from other employers, as we maintain a dedicated staff to ensure quality service and safety for our patrons.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – Active Leisure Club currently carries workers' compensation insurance to ensure compliance and protect against any employee-related injuries or claims.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: Yes – Active Leisure Club also owns and operates Active Leisure Sportswear, LLC, which focuses on providing athletic apparel and equipment to support an active lifestyle for the community. This business complements our primary operations and promotes our brand within the recreational space.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Active Leisure Club does not have any other insurance policies with this company at this time. The only policy in effect is for the current coverage year.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Active Leisure Club is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. Our operations focus solely on providing recreational services and activities for our members.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Active Leisure Club does not rent or loan equipment to others. Our focus is on providing safe and enjoyable recreational activities for our members without exposing the facility to additional liability risks associated with equipment rentals.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – Active Leisure Club has not experienced any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien in the past five years, reflecting our strong financial standing and operational stability.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Active Leisure Club does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals in its operations. The facility is focused on providing safe recreational activities without such risks.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Active Leisure Club does not have any identified catastrophe exposure at this time, as we have implemented robust safety measures and regularly evaluate potential risks. Our focus on moderate-risk activities further minimizes exposure.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – There have been no past losses or claims related to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring at Active Leisure Club. The organization is committed to maintaining a safe and inclusive environment for all patrons and employees.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – Active Leisure Club currently has no uncorrected fire code violations, ensuring compliance with all relevant safety regulations. We prioritize maintaining a safe environment for our patrons and staff.
